partner_thoughts.thought: Tax planning is not about avoidance — it is about structuring transactions intelligently within the framework of the law to achieve the best possible outcome for the client.
Every litigation is a story — the taxpayer's story of compliance and intent. Our job is to tell that story compellingly before the highest judicial forums.
Transfer pricing is where economics meets law. Getting it right requires both a deep understanding of business models and a mastery of regulatory frameworks across jurisdictions.
Great M&A deals are built on three pillars: legal certainty, tax efficiency, and commercial pragmatism. Miss any one and the deal crumbles at integration.
